deployments.summary: Routing hotfix: supermarket goal cards opened a different plan than they advertised ("Lidl Weight Loss Plan" -> "Lidl Very Cheap Batch Cook Weight Loss Plan"). Root cause was an inverted effort tie-break in a duplicated additive scorer (batch +6 vs standard +5, 94 beats 93), plus cards synthesising their own heading instead of showing the destination's title. Replaced both chooser resolvers with one lexicographic canonical resolver (src/utils/planRecommendation.js); cards now display the destination plan's own title; unmatched combinations are named rather than silently dropped. 348 combinations audited, 0 mismatches after. Production verified: 231 cards across 32 routes, 133 destinations, 0 title mismatches.
